Results.ReviewText: Nice grill and perfect for the 2 of us.  This is our second spirit grill in 5 years.  We had already replaced our burners one time on our last Weber grill and it was time again as they do wear/rust out in the Florida heat and humidity.  We chose this style and brand because of how well it cooks.  We have owned several different brands over the years and Weber seems to last the longest.  Replacing the tank can be tricky as you attach it to a hook underneath the grill that will give you the fuel level in the tank so you know when you are about to run out.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210 grill

Results.ReviewText:
Over the years, I have spent money on flash, inexpensive gas grills that looked great but failed to perform.  This year, I decided to buy a E-210 based on reports and my experience with the kettle charcoal.  What a difference.  The grill is solid, not flimsy and both the starter and the temp gauge still work perfectly.  It is easy to work with and a bit more 
expensive, but I obviously  got what I paid for and expected.  Probably my last gas grill, but could not be happier.  Spend a bit more and you'll be happy!
Results.Title: Sturdy and reliable

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
